name: sel-subset-gate
notes: §11.1 MUST: a proven `subset` narrowing must never read as a clean gate pass, and an unproven (perturbed) narrowing must never be claimed at all. Run A (no selector) is recorded at c1; a marker commit (c2) keeps A and B content-distinct; run B (`src`) is a proven prefix subset of A -- gate g1 (ref resolving to c1, run B) must therefore report `comparability: 'subset'` with `selector_subset` triggered and `verdict: 'fail'`, even though every observation stayed green (no `new_fail`) -- the fail is the proof of narrowing itself, not a regression. Run C (`-t alpha src`, still at c2's tree) and run D (`-t alpha src/sub`, after a second marker commit c3) both carry the `-t`/`--testNamePattern` scope-perturbing flag (issue decision 4): even though the positional selectors alone (`src` -> `src/sub`) would be a further prefix subset, `commandScopePerturbed` forces the comparator to abstain -- gate g2 (ref resolving to c2, run D) must report `comparability: 'none'`, reason `selector-relation-unknown`, and `verdict: 'inconclusive'` (never `pass`, never a narrowing claim under perturbation). Every test name includes 'alpha' so the `-t alpha` runs never empty-match.

steps.message: c1: seed alpha-named green tests under src/, src/sub/, tests/

steps.content: advance tree before B (keep A and B content-distinct)
advance tree before D (keep C and D content-distinct)
